<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Compute what a sync *would* change, as a reviewable artifact.

Read-only: nothing is written to the destination, no watermark advances,
no run state is persisted. A destination that cannot report its current
contents yields "plan unavailable" with a reason (exit 1) instead of a
partial plan.

Examples:

```
drt plan orders_to_pg --out plan.json
drt plan orders_to_pg --out plan.json --detailed-exitcode
drt plan --all --out-dir plans --output markdown   # one PR comment for every sync
```

## Usage

```bash
drt plan [OPTIONS] [SYNC_NAME]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[SYNC_NAME]` | no | Name of the sync to plan (or use --all). |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Plan every sync (for CI). Writes one &lt;sync&gt;.json per plannable sync into --out-dir; a sync that cannot be planned is reported, not fatal. |
| `--out-dir` | `PATH` | `plans` | Where --all writes the per-sync plans. |
| `--out` | `PATH` |  | Write the plan to this file (plan.json). Omit to only summarize. |
| `--output`, `-o` | `TEXT` | `text` | Stdout format: text (summary), json (the full plan) or markdown (PR comment). |
| `--detailed-exitcode` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Exit 0 when there are no changes, 2 when changes are present (1 stays an error). |
| `--redact-keys` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Hash key values in the plan instead of showing them (sync.mask columns are always hashed). |
| `--cursor-value` | `TEXT` |  | Override the cursor/watermark for incremental syncs. |
| `--vars` | `TEXT` |  | Override project vars, as for `drt run`. |
| `--profile`, `-p` | `TEXT` |  | Override profile. |
